Q192.reason: The friend agreed to help and drove the young man to the scene, forming a conspiracy despite his private motive, and he is also liable as a principal in the second degree.

Q193.reason: Under Plyler v. Doe, denying education to undocumented children through a fee is invalid because it is not substantially related to an important governmental interest.

Q194.reason: Delivering 490 of 500 widgets is substantial performance, so the buyer cannot recover for breach absent a material failure.
